brief.title: Find hook moments in the long cut
brief.plain_summary: Rank moments of the long cut that can open a short one: visible change within half a second, a line with named curiosity devices, meaning without setup, and a payoff the cut-down can include, without writing any new line.

source_cut.description: Pin of the long cut's encoded file media noun.

caption_track.description: Pin of the long cut's caption track.

panel_set.description: Pin of the long cut's panels, for visible change.

output_store.description: Store for the produced nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.delivery: Write produced nouns surface_only under your own authenticated surface, which is the requester's assigned surface, so the requester and that surface's reviewers can read them. Never use public_commons or allowlist other surfaces. Return every produced noun's pin in output.artifacts; add its value when the requester asks for inline delivery.
